# Official Bellatrix slot transitions

All seven cases from `tests/minimal/bellatrix/sanity/slots/pyspec_tests` at
ethereum/consensus-spec-tests commit `bc5c1a7fb2a8871aaffd4b16ee4dd9c72bb81908`.
The manifest records original Snappy bytes, decompressed pre/post SSZ, slot
counts, file sizes and SHA-256. These vectors qualify the selected slot suite,
not full signed block execution, network activation or production readiness.
